title: catalog.tenant_tour v1 (CIS → TripPlanner)
description: The tours an agency tenant made its own, with the tenant's own text, as the CIS view catalog.v_tenant_tour_v1 exposes them (AA-1094, CIS migration 403; root ADR 0019 d10: 'tours from catalog.v_tenant_tour_v1'). `tours` = rows of the view: one row per (tenant, AA catalogue key) for a tenant in service (trial, active, past_due; kind internal excluded) holding a TripPlanner subscription, for every LIVE AA tour (catalog.v_tour, root ADR 0015: a retired or paused tour is never a row) of which the tenant has a finished, not rejected T2 version (status approved, ai_generated or needs_review). The text is the latest such version of the key (created_at, then version_number; a version written for an older AA source version of the same key counts). A blank text field is null; a blank title falls back to AA's. The facts (country, duration, best time, cover, photo count) are AA's of the live tour; tour_id and slug are the live AA tour's. A tour still being written, or whose versions all failed or were rejected, is not listed (no AA-text fallback under the agency's brand). SELECT to `tripplanner` only (contracts rule 5); TripPlanner reads it after resolving a served tenant (catalog.v_tenant_tripplanner_v1) and filters by tenant_id. Read on demand; consumers re-read on content_hash. Columns may be appended (minor); removing or renaming one needs a v2 view (contracts README rule 2). No price (the agency is the merchant of record, root ADR 0019 b5), no score or gate output (the tenant projection rule), no personal data.

source_id.description: The AA catalogue key (catalog.v_tour source_id); stable across AA source re-uploads.

tour_id.description: The live AA tour version of the key (catalog.v_tour tour_id).

slug.description: The live AA tour's slug (catalog.v_tour slug; its suffix is the first 8 hex characters of source_id).

title.description: The tenant's title (AA's when the tenant's is blank).

highlights.description: The tenant's highlights ([] when its version holds no list).

itinerary_text.description: The tenant's day-by-day text as one string.

country.description: AA's country of the live tour (free text, as catalog.v_tour).

cover_photo_path.description: The live AA tour's cover photo path (catalog.v_tour), served by the CIS photo route.

version_id.description: The tenant tour version whose text this row carries.

edit_source.description: Who wrote the version: a model's rewrite, or the tenant's edit of earlier text.

text_updated_at.description: When the version was created (the AI mark's generated_at for a model's rewrite, EU AI Act Art. 50(2)).

content_hash.description: md5 of the served text, facts and version id; re-read on change.
